title: Italian Mushroom Pilaf
description: A hearty Italian-inspired pilaf dish loaded with sautéed mushrooms. Serve as a side or add to your favorite main course.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the golden pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley.
